name: before-after
title: Before and after
description: Two photos of the same place on top of each other, with a handle that wipes from before to after.

props.name: after
props.description: The after photo, taken from the same spot.

props.name: initial
props.description: Where the handle starts, in per cent from the left.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width to height of the frame, as CSS `aspect-ratio`. Both photos are cropped to it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new position (0–100) when it changes.

a11y.text: The handle is a real range input, hidden but focusable. Tab focuses it, arrows move 1 %, Page Up and Page Down 10 %, Home and End go to the ends.

The input is named by labels.slider and its value is read as labels.value, "40 % before" by default. Both photos keep their own alt text, so each is described. The chips and the handle drawing are aria-hidden.
Focus shows as a 2 px ring with offset on the round handle, through peer-focus-visible on the hidden input.
The handle is 44 px. The frame has touch-action pan-y, so a vertical swipe scrolls the page and only a sideways drag moves the handle.
Nothing animates by itself. The handle only follows the pointer or the key, so reduced motion needs no change.
